events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 31 Dec 2026. Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont. 2-3 social events and 1-2 adventure rides.

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season with indoor training January, weekend practices February, and 2 rides per week March-May. Races begin early March with 5-6 races across North Carolina through end of May.
